prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original source-candidate owner portrait; future circular HUD source reviewed at40 and80 pixels.
Task: CP-34.
Primary request: create one head-and-shoulders portrait of Black Panther, faithful to the specific original project character design in the provided image.
Input image1: the supplied project canonical front PNG, not a commercial scan or photograph. Source effective status: returned6.9; separate user override to proceed1b; verdict unchanged. This new portrait is a proposed source only and inherits no formal acceptance.
Subject: Black Panther, the same masked adult hero as the supplied project front: complete black pointed-ear panther mask, narrow white eye slits, precise silver cheek/forehead seams, black and charcoal textured suit, silver claw-tooth necklace. Keep the mask on, with no human face underneath and no hands or blades in frame.
Style/medium: refined original collectible-character rendering consistent with the reference's sculpted forms and hand-painted material treatment. Broad clear value groups and simple readable face landmarks; restrained material detail. No commercial card illustration imitation or movie likeness.
Composition: one square image, head and shoulders only. Centered face, both eyes or mask eye slits directed toward the viewer. Include the entire head, hairstyle, mask ears, headwear and headband tails with generous quiet margin above and on both sides. Whole head and headgear must fit inside the full centered circle inscribed in the square; shoulders may meet the circle edge. Do not draw a circle. No tighter crop required. Upper chest low in frame, no full body or pedestal.
Backdrop: quiet uniform dark navy #061623, no scenery.
Lighting: soft studio illumination, both eyes or mask eye slits and facial landmarks clear. No black eye sockets, lens glare, flare or rim glow.
Constraints: no words, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, frame, border, UI, hands, added props, duplicate face or extra character. No actor features, photograph or scan. Preserve this supplied design and palette as a proposed interpretation; do not imply acceptance or use cropping to relabel upstream source defects.
